1 The young of an animal.
--2 A young plant.
--3 The site of a
house.

पोतृ m.
1 One of the sixteen
officiating priests at a sacrifice
(assistant of the priest called ब्रह्मन्).
--2 An epithet of Viṣṇu.

पोत्रं [पू-त्र]
1 The snout of a hog.
--2 A boat, ship.
--3 A plough
share.
--4 The thunderbolt.
--5 A
garment.
--6 The office of the Potṛ.
--Comp.
--आयुधः a hog, boar.
